grasp.why: It is in their hands, so it moves with them.

wear.why: They are wearing it, so it moves with them.

ride.why: Rider and ride move together between shots.

seat.why: Seats and beds stay where they are; the person sits on them.

enclose.why: Vehicles they are in or beside stay where they are.

companion.why: Animals have their own pose; swap them separately unless they are being carried.

fixture.why: Fixed things and appliances stay where they are.

play.why: In-play things are mid-air or on the ground; they only move with the person while held.
